policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Saginaw Valley State beat Purdue Northwest to stay above Northern Michigan, who beat Roosevelt on the same day. Northern Michigan have scored 32 goals across all their matches, more than any other programme in the conference, and the two sides meet again at Northern Michigan before the season closes.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: The scoring is top-heavy: Northern Michigan alone have scored more than Purdue Northwest and St. Cloud State together.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Saginaw Valley State have lost once all season, and still have a trip to Northern Michigan to come.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Nine matches whose dates have passed carry no published result, the earliest of them Northern Michigan's opening match against Green Bay.

claims.text: Matty Telfer has scored thirteen of Saginaw Valley State's 29 goals, from 46 shots.
